name: PPT Master（高级）
description: An opt-in advanced PowerPoint workflow for template filling, reconstruction, native enhancement, animation, narration, and deep visual review.

parameters.name: source_path
parameters.description: Optional source PPTX, template, image, PDF, DOCX, or source material

parameters.name: animation
parameters.description: Whether the selected route should add native animation

parameters.name: narration
parameters.description: Whether the selected route should add narration

routing.useWhen: Use only when the user explicitly invokes PPT Master or selects the advanced PPT mode for native template filling, reconstruction, enhancement, animation, narration, or deep review.
routing.dontUseWhen: Do not auto-use for ordinary PPT creation, generic slide requests, or mentions of presentations. Those use Presentation Studio unless the user explicitly selects this skill.
routing.outputs: A task-scoped advanced PPT Master project, exactly one final versioned native PPTX, and delivery validation.
routing.successCriteria: The selected route completes its gates, the PPTX passes delivery checks, and the final response reports missing optional dependencies or incomplete visual review.
